scope: Eight historical chamber-search masks; physical anatomy unaccepted
selection: Every original face from each of the eight frozen masks; no fit-driven trimming or mask replacement
upstream_admission: Pinned original arrays/masks, no original indexed intersection face, valid source manifold charts, no source welding or coordinate change
split: Original vertex ID modulo five: zero held out, other remainders training
frame: Weighted training-only principal frame; coordinate normalization from training only
weighting: Original triangle area divided equally among its vertices; inherited full-mask geometry makes this transductive within-scan evaluation
whole_triangle_check: Degree-two Bernstein convex-hull bound on the graph-height difference over every original triangle; no surface extension outside the projected original triangles
limit_role: Existing digital reconstruction screen, not a physical tolerance or scanner uncertainty
native_surface_admission: Whole-triangle bound must pass; projection/trim topology and actual native export checks remain separately required
rejection_policy: Retain every rejection and observed source surface; no higher degree, alternative split, threshold relaxation or paid sweep in this trial
